title: Shoplifter Tries To Fight Off Manager After She Gets Caught Stealing
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On February 20th, 2023. A store manager called 911 in regards to a homeless shoplifter who walked out of the store with a basket full of items. When the manager  attempted to stop her, she claimed that it was her items and she didn’t steal it. The manager and the woman began fighting because the shoplifter refused to let go of the basket. The woman had an accomplice who was helping her and was threatening one of the witnesses with a knife. The woman then fled the scene and ran into the woods, where she was eventually arrested. When the officer approached her, she started to say that the manager attacked her for no reason. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.

#news #police #arrest
